title: Speaking — Shared responsibilities
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on shared responsibilities.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
What household jobs do you prefer to do yourself?
How do people where you live decide who does each task?

part2.topic: Describe a responsibility you took on to help a group.
part2.closing: and explain what made you willing to take it on.

questions: How can families share responsibilities fairly when members have different schedules?
What helps employees cooperate on work outside their usual job roles?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to shared responsibilities?
